pageDescription: Find daily Boss spots, position your boat, and use reference photos to place black water.
fieldTitle: Find your spot. Cast with confidence.
fieldBody: Place black water using the reference photos, then wait for bubbles before fishing.
heroDescription: Find the spot, position your boat, and check where to place black water.
dateHint: “Today” means the active date. Before reset, the previous day’s spots still apply. Reset times use your device’s local time.
activePointLabel: Spot {point}, active for the selected date
waterAlt: {name}, spot {point}, black-water position {index}; approximate area only
missingWaterHint: Try another spot for a reference photo.
waterHint: Photos show an {area}. Use shorelines, islands, and buildings to help place black water.
enlargeMap: Enlarge the boat-position map for {name}, spot {point}
missingMapHint: Use the terrain in the reference photo to estimate where to stop your boat.
mapCaption: Numbered markers are confirmed boat position references. Select a marker to switch spots, then compare scene references for black-water placement.
step1: Position your boat using the map or photo.
step2: Place black water in the indicated area.
step3: Wait for bubbles, then start fishing.
stepsNote: Place, wait for bubbles, then fish.
footerTagline: A field guide for deep-sea anglers
viewerMapDescription: Map reference: use it to position your boat.
viewerWaterDescription: Black-water position {index}: approximate area only. Wait for bubbles before fishing.
copyDescription: Automatic copying was unavailable. Select the text below and copy it manually.
copyHeader: Boss spots for {date} — {region} (reset at {hour}:00, device local time)
copyFooter: After placing black water, wait for bubbles before fishing. Community reference; check conditions in-game.
helpSubtitle: Find the spot, position your boat, place black water
helpPositionTitle: Map for the boat, photo for placement
helpPositionBody: Each destination uses a shared full map. Numbered markers show confirmed boat position references. Unconfirmed positions are not marked; compare scene references for terrain. Wait for bubbles after placing black water before fishing.
helpResetBody: Reset is at 05:00 for North America and 04:00 for other regions, using your device’s local time. Choose your server region. “Yesterday” and “Tomorrow” are relative to the currently active date.
helpAtlasBody: Choose a map and spot number. A dot marks the spot for the selected date. Click an image to enlarge it. Use thumbnails or the previous and next buttons to switch between multiple references.
helpDataNote: Spots are estimated from a community-maintained 26-day cycle. Check conditions in-game.
mapPickerHint: {date} · Choose a map to view its spot.
mapZoomHint: Zoom in, then scroll to explore
markerPlaceHint: Click the map to place the marker
markerPending: Boat position for spot {point} is not confirmed
markerPendingHint: Use the base map and scene references for now. Unconfirmed positions are not marked.
editorIntro: Choose a spot, compare references, place and verify. Save for the next site release.
editorLocalOnly: Open this workspace through npm run dev locally.
editorStorageWarning: Browser draft storage is unavailable or unreadable. Export a JSON backup.
editorRecoverHint: An unsaved browser draft is available.
editorRecoverConflict: An older draft exists, but project data has changed. Export it for reference and keep the current project data to avoid overwriting newer edits.
editorImported: Imported into the workspace; undo is available. Review before saving to the project.
editorImportInvalid: Import failed: invalid format, map, spot, coordinates, or file larger than 128 KB.
editorPreviewHint: Release preview: only confirmed markers on the current base map are shown. You can still switch maps and spots.
editorSaved: Saved to the project with a backup of the previous version. Run checks, then commit and push to publish.
editorConflict: Save blocked: project data or base maps changed. Export a draft backup, then reload and review.
editorSaveFailed: Save failed. Check the local development server.
editorBaseChanged: The base map has changed. Existing coordinates require review and will not appear on the public site.
editorReviewBase: Use current base and reset to drafts
editorPlaceHelp: Choose a spot and enable placement. Click to place; zoom and scroll to inspect.
editorNoteHint: For example: northwest of the central island, near the shallows.
editorConfirmHint: Verify against the game map, shorelines and scene references. Coordinate or note edits reset confirmation.
editorReferenceHelp: Compare terrain with these photos. Coordinates are not inferred automatically.
editorPublish1: Confirm each checked position. Partial releases are supported.
editorPublish2: Save to the project, then run npm test and npm run build.
editorPublish3: Commit coordinates and base map assets, then push to the deployment branch. GitHub Actions publishes the site.
